name: augenmass-workbench
description: A Codex skill and Rust CLI for developers, auditors, privacy reviewers, and product teams working in the EUDI Wallet ecosystem: audit registrations for over-ask, decode and verify wallet artifacts, debug live wallet flows, explain findings plainly, and produce concrete fixes.

interface.shortDescription: EUDI wallet skill for over-ask review, debugging, and fixes.
interface.longDescription: Ask Codex in plain language to inspect EUDI wallet artifacts, audit relying-party registrations for over-asking, explain privacy findings for non-technical reviewers, debug live verifier flows, and produce concrete fixes. The skill is backed by the bundled Rust CLI when platform-compatible, or by AUGENMASS_BIN on other platforms.
defaultPrompt: Use the augenmass skill: show the purpose baselines, generate a proportionate age-check body, and check it.
Use the augenmass skill: explain why a full birthdate is too much for an over-18 check, and cite the basis.
Use the augenmass skill: in plain language, what should an age-check service ask for and what should it avoid?
Use the augenmass skill: prepare a safe live wallet debug run with redacted traces.
